workspace: 积木战争 · 原创配乐候选
exclude_styles: vocals, singing, humming, choir, chanting, spoken words, lyrics, EDM drops, trap hi-hats, distorted guitars, braams, huge trailer drums, cymbal crashes, aggressive sub-bass, abrupt tempo changes, grand finale, battle sound effects

tracks.title: 积木战争 01｜林间小军团
tracks.use: 主风格候选；裂谷交汇、小型地图常规对局
tracks.prompt: Instrumental whimsical woodland strategy-game soundtrack, a small army of brave little wooden villagers marching through a sunlit forest. 112 BPM, steady 4/4, buoyant but restrained. Playful bassoon and clarinet trade a short original four-note motif over nimble pizzicato strings, soft wooden marimba, plucked upright bass, dry woodblocks and light frame drums. Rustic chamber orchestra with a tactile handmade character, gentle Dorian folk color, sly humor and quiet determination. A clear rhythmic pulse supports planning, building and troop movement. Begin with the groove immediately; develop in balanced 8-bar phrases, alternate sparse and lightly fuller textures, then return to the opening instrumentation. Keep medium-low intensity, plenty of breathing room, small melodic variations and a clean mix that leaves space for game sound effects. Three-minute loop-oriented background cue; understated ending on the same pulse, no theatrical climax.

tracks.title: 积木战争 02｜炉火与新屋
tracks.use: 选图、开局发展；林湖回廊与慢节奏经营
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cozy rustic village-building game music, industrious little woodland people raising houses and tending a small forge. 92 BPM, gentle lilting 6/8, warm and quietly busy rather than sleepy. Fingerpicked nylon-string guitar and lute, hammered dulcimer, rounded wooden marimba, mellow clarinet, soft pizzicato cello and a very light brushed frame drum. A simple original folk melody passes between dulcimer and clarinet above a repeating plucked pattern. Earthy acoustic chamber sound, intimate room ambience, soft edges, clear separation. Suggest progress, resource gathering and friendly teamwork. Start with a complete gentle groove, use balanced 8-bar phrases and modest instrumental variations; a short airy middle section returns naturally to the first motif. Keep the same relaxed energy throughout, spacious midrange and restrained bass. Three-minute loop-oriented gameplay underscore, no big build or final flourish.

tracks.title: 积木战争 03｜苔影绕行
tracks.use: 断脊山道、迂回绕后、双方蓄兵阶段
tracks.prompt: Instrumental mischievous tactical woodland game underscore, tiny scouts slipping around mossy rocks while their village quietly prepares. 104 BPM, measured 4/4, nimble and curious with mild suspense. Bass clarinet and bassoon in short question-and-answer phrases, pizzicato viola and cello, muted wooden marimba, dry woodblock ticks and fingertip hand percussion. Dorian minor folk harmony with occasional warm major turns; an original compact motif feels clever and slightly comic, never frightening. Small acoustic chamber ensemble, detailed rhythm, gentle syncopation, no booming low end. Keep the pulse steady for thoughtful strategy play, leaving open space for orders and footsteps. Begin promptly; alternate an 8-bar pizzicato figure with a woodwind reply, briefly thin the texture, then return with a subtle counterline. Three-minute loop-oriented cue with restrained dynamics and an understated cyclical ending.

tracks.title: 积木战争 04｜石桥鼓阵
tracks.use: 双河平原、桥头争夺、中盘交战
tracks.prompt: Instrumental playful acoustic battle music for a colorful small-scale strategy game, determined little troops contesting a stone bridge. 124 BPM, firm 4/4, energetic but controlled. Interlocking hand drums, dry frame drum, small low toms and woodblocks create a crisp marching groove; staccato strings, plucked bass, bassoon and brief warm French-horn replies carry a short original folk motif. Rustic chamber orchestra and earthy percussion, agile and spirited rather than massive or menacing. Use a clear rhythmic backbone and short melodic calls, with space between accents so cannon and command effects remain audible. Start directly in the groove, alternate 8-bar percussion-led and melody-led phrases, include one lighter passage, and return to the initial rhythm. Stable tempo and moderate dynamics, no escalating trailer build. Three-minute loop-oriented battle underscore, no giant ending hit.

tracks.title: 积木战争 05｜群岛风帆
tracks.use: 群岛长滩、跨桥调兵、探索与侧翼扩张
tracks.prompt: Instrumental breezy island-folk strategy-game soundtrack, little wooden armies traveling between green islands on a bright coastal morning. 108 BPM, lilting 6/8 with a gentle forward sway. Wooden flute and mandolin share an original compact melody, supported by hammered dulcimer, light fiddle responses, pizzicato cello, soft hand drum and delicate shaker. Airy acoustic folk chamber arrangement, warm salt-air atmosphere, friendly adventure and alert curiosity. Keep the melody modest and repeatable, with short call-and-response phrases and a steady plucked ostinato. Neither a drinking song nor a pirate anthem; focus on peaceful expansion and nimble coordination. Open with the main pulse, add and remove one instrument at a time across balanced 8-bar phrases, return to the opening flute figure. Clean spacious mix, restrained percussion and low end. Three-minute loop-oriented gameplay cue with an unobtrusive cyclical ending.

tracks.title: 积木战争 06｜三旗并进
tracks.use: 环湖高原、3v3 联盟推进、后期会合
tracks.prompt: Instrumental warm heroic woodland strategy-game music, three small allied clans raising their flags and advancing together. 116 BPM, steady 4/4, optimistic resolve with a playful human scale. Clarinet, bassoon and a soft French horn exchange three related original melodic phrases, each answering the others. Pizzicato strings, lightly bowed violin countermelodies, hammered dulcimer, plucked acoustic bass, frame drum and restrained low toms. A rustic chamber-orchestral march with friendly folk harmony, rounded tone and subtle rhythmic drive. Convey teamwork and earned confidence without bombast. Start with the established pulse, build only to a modest ensemble statement, step back to woodwinds, then bring the three phrases together over the same groove. Balanced 8-bar sections, stable medium intensity, open mix for gameplay sound effects. Three-minute loop-oriented cue; return to the initial texture without a victory fanfare or grand finale.
